percent_meaning: Subjective research progress, not independent Lean proof coverage, probability, or permission to promote manuscript status; status promotions require exact-head full kernel and axiom audit.

targets.title: Original polynomial-time writers
targets.evidence: Kernel-verified at the original scope. For every polynomial p, machine M and input, the actual machines windowMTM p and inputMTM M p write originalWindowCode p x and originalInputCode M p x at their first halt within explicit polynomial transition bounds (windowMTM_outputs, inputMTM_outputs). Hence originalWindowCode_fp, originalInputCode_fp, the unconditional originalWM, originalWM_first_answer (T_W = 2 T_M), originalWM_decides and P_Turing_subset_P_disc_by_original. Gate scripts/verify_ii10_original_wm.sh passed on commit df8824c: Lean 4.23.0, lake build PVNP 7,386 jobs, 627 audited declarations with standard axioms only, 24 Python regression tests.
targets.remaining_obligation: None for the original claim. GitHub-hosted CI has not executed for this head (issue #59); the kernel evidence is the local exact-head gate.

targets.title: Uniform separator theorem
targets.evidence: Refuted for the frozen physical trajectory class. SeparatorFrozen.no_uniform_separator_price: on the torus of side L, the exact plane-wave solutions of fixed amplitude A have curvature functional at most 4π²|A|² + 16π⁴c²|A|²/L² (any curvature operator dominated by c|Δψ|, including Δ and the Part III Θ_ε), while the Euclidean length of the frontier of the decision region {Re ψ > 0} is at least L, at every time. These fields are used by an admissible decider (stripe_device_decides); the modulus readout fails the same way (no_uniform_price_modulus). Corrected statement: layer_price (sharp width-dependent price 4η²/w).
targets.remaining_obligation: None for the original hypothesis. A uniform price needs an extra hypothesis bounding transition widths (sharp interfaces), under which SeparatorPrice.mesh_price and SeparatorFrozen.layer_price apply.

targets.title: General toroidal locking
targets.evidence: InterwovenSAT.toroidal_locking_iff_unsat (PR #90): with locking configurations defined as points of the configuration torus |ψᵢ| = 1 where clause penalties and sign-blind coupling/curvature vanish, no locking configuration ⟺ unsatisfiable, for every formula. locks_iff_sat_iff gives the exact criterion for any added energy C ≥ 0; naive_toroidal_locking_fails shows sign-sensitive flux terms fail on F_xor. TorusNoLocking: the frozen flow cannot reach a stable lock from outside it.
targets.remaining_obligation: A physical (spatial-torus) ψ–electron realization of the flux constraints together with non-conservative dynamics that reach the locks, with charged preparation and readout; the frozen model cannot provide the convergence.

targets.title: Encoding-independent interface theorem
targets.evidence: ExpanderInterface.expanderGrowth_SAT_iff: in the charged constant-device class the hypothesis for dense SAT is equivalent to P_TM ≠ NP_TM; WCTSATScaling.superpoly_SAT_implies_P_ne_NP (PR #90): any superpolynomial physical-resource lower bound for SAT over a class containing the charged zero-mode torus devices implies P_TM ≠ NP_TM. False for every language in P_TM.
targets.remaining_obligation: Cannot be proved without proving P_TM ≠ NP_TM; in the constant-device class it cannot be refuted without P_TM = NP_TM.

targets.title: Physical SAT dynamics and readout
targets.evidence: InterwovenSAT (PR #90): with unit amplitudes and sign-blind gradient terms, SAT ⟺ ground energy 0 and UNSAT ⟺ ground energy ≥ 1/8 (sat_iff_EminSB_eq_zero, unsat_iff_EminSB_ge); the sign readout below 1/8 satisfies F (measure_satisfies). With the literal sign-sensitive gradient the criterion fails (naive_Emin, satisfying_not_ground). Torus.no_locking_phaseOrbit: the frozen dynamics cannot converge into a binary-phase lock.
targets.remaining_obligation: A formula-dependent non-conservative dynamics that drives the sign-blind energy below 1/8 from a state prepared by an encoder that does not itself decide SAT, with charged time and robust readout.

targets.title: Continuum physical-computation equivalence
targets.evidence: P_disc = P_TM exactly in the uniform discrete model; PhysicalAudit.unrestricted_phys_ne_P_TM for arbitrary encoders. WCTSATScaling.superpoly_SAT_implies_P_ne_NP and torus_superpoly_implies_P_ne_NP (PR #90): physical lower bounds transfer to classical ones without simulation in any class containing the charged zero-mode devices.
targets.remaining_obligation: Prove both charged physical-to-TM simulation and language-independent physical TM realization with PDE approximation errors.

targets.title: Nonconstructible wavefield family
targets.evidence: DepthBarrier.explicit_no_separation: in the explicit-state reading every state is constructed in linear time, so NPst \ Pst = ∅. Conditional symbolic separation template proved earlier.
targets.remaining_obligation: Fix a state notion (input-indexed families or physical fields with a preparation model) under which the conjecture is non-trivial, then construct or refute a verifiable non-constructible target.

targets.title: Universal SAT lower bound
targets.evidence: DepthBarrier.wccDepth_SAT_iff, wccdDepth_SAT_iff, uniform_depth_SAT_iff: for dense SAT the conjecture is exactly P_TM ≠ NP_TM. WCTSATScaling.zeroSuperpoly_SAT_iff (PR #90): the same for the charged zero-mode devices of the frozen torus model.
targets.remaining_obligation: This is the classical P versus NP question; it is not resolved here, and finite data cannot establish it.

targets.title: Mathematical interpretation and classification
targets.evidence: The §8 remark states that no equivalence P^phys = NP^phys ⟺ retrocausality is proved and keeps the section as a research direction; it asserts no theorem and is classified Interpretive (13 November 2026). Torus.backward_eq_forward_conj and flow_neg give the exact frozen-model form of its sentence on inverse dynamics, as supporting material.
targets.remaining_obligation: None for the interpretive entry. Any future theorem about time reversal and complexity needs its own model, quantifiers and claim identifier.
